# BlurEffect

- Inherits [`PostEffect`](posteffect.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("BlurEffect")`

Softens the whole world picture, as behind a pause menu. The interface is drawn after it and stays sharp. **Several combine as blurs do in optics**: the sizes add by their squares, so two blurs of 8 are one of about 11.3, not one of 16.

**Members below are the ones this class DECLARES.** Everything its base
offers is on the base's page, which is what keeps one added member on
`Instance` from being a change to every page here.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Size` | `number` | `24` | read/write, **inert** | How far a pixel's light is spread, in pixels of a picture 1,080 lines tall -- most of it lands within this distance. It scales with the window, so a blur looks the same at any size. 0 is no blur, and costs nothing. |
